name: Shock Lobster
author: Dave VanEe (tbsp); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Shock Lobster by Dave VanEe (tbsp), a Game Boy Competition 2021 entry: a lowly lobster with magical powers swims forward, jetting over obstacles and zapping enemies; collect pearls to unlock skills, upgrades and items and push your high score higher. Saves on the cartridge. Zlib license (github.com/tbsp/shock-lobster).

descriptions.it: Shock Lobster di Dave VanEe (tbsp), in gara alla Game Boy Competition 2021: un umile astice con poteri magici avanza nuotando, evita gli ostacoli con i getti d'acqua e fulmina i nemici; raccogli perle per sbloccare abilità, potenziamenti e oggetti e migliorare il record. Salvataggi sulla cartuccia. Licenza Zlib (github.com/tbsp/shock-lobster).
